affordance.label: dotdiw create
affordance.shape: Name the work and read what applies, in one invocation.

inputMapping.notes: The one argument that is not a flag or a flag's value.
Matched together with the title. A value that starts with a dash is given as --description=<text>.
The item the work goes under.
The record of the work created, as JSON, and nothing else.
Suppresses what rides along with the create: the match, the re-declaration, the check. The create itself still happens.
Refused in one line naming it, as is one of create's own flags given no value; nothing is created.

coverage.explanation: The command line projects the operation; it decides nothing about what the operation means.

affordance.label: dotdiw <any tracker command>
affordance.shape: Everything the tracker does, under dotdiw's name. Under beads: list, show, close, update, dep, sync, help and the rest, passed through. Under an adapter without a pass-through: list, ready, show, close, update and dep add, answered through the tracker interface and shown as records; any other command is refused.

inputMapping.notes: Taken out of the arguments; also DOTDIW_TRACKER. Given no name, the command is refused in one line before anything runs.

affordance.label: every dotdiw command
affordance.shape: Before the first tracker command of every run, the tracker's usage metrics are off.

affordance.label: every dotdiw command but init, learn and --version
affordance.shape: Before whatever was typed, asks whether an earlier version left a hook override, a tracker in the tree or a workspace with no tracker chosen, changing nothing; while one is left, the command is refused in one line naming dotdiw init, which puts it right.

coverage.explanation: Not a command of its own: a repository is unprotected for as long as the override stands, so every command says so until init puts it right.
